title: G2 (CORE): Choice of preconditioner and an explicit M/N-free condition-number bound for PCG

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** PCG convergence claim for ($\star$).

Natural SPD preconditioner $P_0=\lambda(I_r\otimes K)$ with $P_0^{-1}=\lambda^{-1}(I_r\otimes K^{-1})$ (one Cholesky of $K$, $O(n^3)$ once; apply $O(n^2r)$). Required proof obligations:

1. **Lower bound:** data term is PSD $\Rightarrow P_0^{-1}\mathcal A\succeq I$, i.e. $\lambda_{\min}(P_0^{-1}\mathcal A)=1$.
2. **Upper bound (the hard part):** $\lambda_{\max}(P_0^{-1}\mathcal A)\le 1+\lambda^{-1}\eta$ with $\eta=\|S^\top(Z\otimes K)(I_r\otimes K^{-1/2})\|_2^2\le\|Z\|_2^2\,\|K\|_2$ (using $\|S^\top\|\le1$). Hence $\kappa\le 1+\lambda^{-1}\|Z\|_2^2\|K\|_2$ and iteration count $t=O(\sqrt\kappa\,\log(1/\varepsilon))$ — all independent of $M,N$.

The attempt must give a genuine spectral-equivalence inequality ($\alpha P\preceq\mathcal A\preceq\beta P$) for whatever $P$ it selects, then derive $\kappa$. Numerics in-session: $\kappa(P_0^{-1}\mathcal A)\approx71$ ($n=5,M=40,r=3$); a mean-field variant $\tfrac qN(Z^\top Z\otimes K^2)+\lambda(I_r\otimes K)$ gave $\kappa\approx54$. A heuristic preconditioner without a proved bound is insufficient (benchmark commandment 3).
